_doc: qa-kit-specific per-harness render + install fields for build-qakit-adapter.sh (increment 7, ADR-0024). Shared harness facts live in the engine's harness-profiles.json (read-only); this file adds only what qa-kit needs. skillRef/engineRun templates use {name} as the skill/command placeholder. No QAKIT_CMD token: bare /qa-<step> command refs are left literal (they read fine on every harness). pluginRoot is where qa-kit's OWN scripts/templates install (per-plugin root); it is NOT the engine skills path (bare-name skill refs resolve from the engine adapter's co-installed shared skills dir).
